name: pi-prospects-engine
description: pi-system client prospect organizer — a self-hosted, operator-owned CRM-lite for a MANUAL client-acquisition workflow. Pure Node, no deps. It ORGANIZES a pipeline the operator enters by hand and ANALYZES a prospect's OWN public website by REUSING services/seo (no parallel analyzer). It NEVER scrapes any platform and NEVER sends or bulk-sends outreach — the operator contacts prospects manually. The optional AI enrichment is the same inert-until-keyed seam as the SEO engine.
